sections.Profile:
"Joker Poker," released by Gottlieb in June 1978, is a classic pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. It features a card game theme and is available in both solid-state and electro-mechanical versions.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Gambling, Card games, Casino, 1970s, Solid State, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
sections.Editions:
- Joker Poker: 9,280 made, released 1978-01-08, model number 417 SS, Gottlieb System 1
- Joker Poker (EM): 820 made, released 1978-08-01, model number 417
